# cloady_workspace (Data Source)

Look up an existing workspace without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloady_workspace" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Workspace slug.

### Read-Only

- `hues` (List of Number) Workspace brand hue angles.
- `id` (String) Workspace slug.
- `managed_backups` (Boolean) Whether the managed backups add-on is on.
- `name` (String) Display name.
